Preserve exact compass E,SE,S,SW,W,NW,N,NE: right side/front-right/front/front-left/left side/back-left/full back/back-right. Preserve exact original black helmet/armor with golden spikes, teal crest, tattered cloak, cyan scythe and hand anatomy. Do not change ANY of the bottom4rows, especially final3 kneeling/falling/flat DEATH poses. Keep EXACT8columns5rows=40different articulated poses. Transparent RGBA empty background; no scenery, fog, grids or text. No body scale change across rows; just lower raised weapon and recoil the shoulders/head in top row.
